items.title: Trump and Big Tech keep pushing AI technology we don't want | Opinion
items.snippet: Even President Donald Trump has embraced AI. At a summit with a bevy of tech tit...
items.raw_snippet: Even President Donald Trump has embraced AI. At a summit with a bevy of tech titans on Sept. 29, with everyone from Google CEO Sundar Pichai to Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, among others, they signed an agreement to use safeguards with AI to avoid a potential AI-related apocalypse. Most, if not all, of the tech gurus believe that AI will be an intimate part of everyone's everyday lives in under a decade. [...] In a CBS News interview, Amodei predicted that AI could reduce entry-level white-collar jobs by half, spiking unemployment in five years or less. Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, who also attended Trump's summit, has said that within 10 to 20 years, work will be optional, just like people who grow vegetables because they like gardening, even though buying vegetables at a grocery store is more convenient. [...] Still, Big Tech gurus constantly tell me the future we are in is infinitely better than the future promised because artificial intelligence has arrived. AI is at once our savior, our maid, our assistant, our boss and − if all goes topsy-turvy − our undertaker, too.
